data.name: Eugenius
data.gender_notes: Eugenius is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'eugenios', meaning 'well-born' or 'noble'. The name Eugenius was commonly given to children born into noble families in ancient Rome. It was also used as a name for popes, emperors, and saints throughout history. The name Eugenius carries the meaning “Well-born, noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eugenius usually hope their child will grow to embody well-born, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of noble character, symbolizing virtues such as kindness, generosity, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Eugenius belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Well-born, noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eugenius total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_greek.name: Εὐγένιος
in_greek.long_meaning: Well born, of noble descent, Noble

data.cultural_impact: The name Eugenius signifies a noble and respectable heritage, reflecting the royal or affluent background of the bearer. It was popular within the Roman aristocracy and continued to be used amongst the European nobility and beyond, leaving an indelible mark on the pages of history.
data.spiritual_significance: Eugenius can also be interpreted as a spiritual name, emphasizing the idea of being well-born in the divine sense. The name carries a connotation of being blessed, favored, and protected by God. Eugenius is a reminder that true nobility is not determined by material possessions or family lineage, but by the grace and love of God. This spiritual significance continues to resonate with people today, inspiring them to strive for inner nobility and character.
data.spiritual_symbolism: As a name associated with Saint Eugenius I, it represents holiness, devotion, and Christian virtue.
